description: This file defines a PHP class WorkflowStateModel that represents a model for workflow states in an HRM system. It includes serialization annotations, a constructor, and a method to convert the object into an array format suitable for API responses. The class depends on an external entity WorkflowStateMachine.

classes.name: WorkflowStateModel
classes.description: A model class representing a workflow state with serialization support, encapsulating a WorkflowStateMachine entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WorkflowStateModel with a WorkflowStateMachine entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model into an associative array with 'action' and 'name' keys for API responses.
